definitions.name: Latent volatility
definitions.formula: high if filtered P(high) >= 0.5; order states by unconditional variance

definitions.name: Equity market
definitions.formula: P(t)/P(t-60)-1; below -0.05 bear, above +0.05 bull, otherwise stable

definitions.name: Monetary policy
definitions.formula: Latest published decision: cut/easing, unchanged/hold, hike/tightening; retain until next decision

definitions.name: Inflation momentum
definitions.formula: Latest released YoY minus previous released YoY; below -0.25 pp falling, above +0.25 pp rising, otherwise stable

definitions.name: Economic growth
definitions.formula: Latest released IIP YoY below -1 pp contraction, above +1 pp expansion, otherwise stable

definitions.name: INR pressure
definitions.formula: Prior-date quote aligned strictly to next Indian session, then 20-session return; below -0.01 appreciation, above +0.01 depreciation

definitions.name: Commodity cycle
definitions.formula: Equal category weights and equal within-category weights of daily log returns divided by training SD; sum 60 sessions, classify by training 0.33/0.67 quantiles

definitions.name: Rates and liquidity
definitions.formula: Spread in percentage points; below training q0.33 loose, above q0.67 tight, otherwise neutral

definitions.name: Risk sentiment
definitions.formula: Current India VIX below prior 252-session q0.25 risk_on, above q0.75 risk_off, otherwise neutral; exclude current observation from thresholds

definitions.name: Network leadership
definitions.formula: Rolling lag-5 HAC Granger p<0.05 direction counts. Balance=(out-in)/(out+in). Fewer than 3 links is diffuse; otherwise balance >0.2 hub_led, <-0.2 stock_led, else diffuse. Zero tested directions is unavailable.

ms.gap_policy: reset filter after each missing original panel row; never bridge missing lags
ms.state_order: omega/(1-alpha-beta) ordering proxy, not claimed exact MS-GARCH unconditional variance
ms.tuning: fixed baseline; no validation or test hyperparameter search
ms.inference_scope: exploratory; posterior mean innovations do not propagate full VECM uncertainty

benchmark.purpose: Same-date predictive-density reference for diagnostic-pass two-state MS-GARCH models
benchmark.model: Zero-mean Gaussian single-state GARCH(1,1) on training-standardized stock innovations
benchmark.training: Exactly the frozen Phase 4 block, using the saved Phase 7 training mean and SD
benchmark.test: 2024 onward, same observed innovation dates as the switching model
benchmark.gap_policy: Reset variance to training fitted unconditional variance after a missing original-panel row and at holdout start

hedge.purpose: Complete descriptive regime comparisons, calibration and prior-study-style synthetic hedge figures from frozen Phase 4/7 results
hedge.regime_source: existing regime_join_snapshot; provisional external v2 flags retained; inactive candidates excluded
hedge.return_definition: expm1 of adjacent log-panel differences; no return across missing original panel rows
hedge.signal_timing: All probability, regime and rolling-beta signals at native horizon close t are mapped to next panel date t+1; probability must have position difference 1
hedge.wealth_scope: Diagnostic-pass models and price-like log hubs only; native-quote synthetic research paths. Rates, quantity fundamentals and failed models have no strategy claim.
hedge.position_accounting: Compare each dimension on identical dates for unhedged/full/volatility/overlay rules. Restart each disconnected observable segment flat, charge entry and terminal liquidation, and never accrue a missing return. Segment wealth is linked only over observed intervals.
hedge.overlay_origin: market and leadership inherit previous-study .25/.5/1 idea; policy adds explicit hold; remaining mappings are fixed illustrative sensitivity choices, not optimized economic conclusions
hedge.missing_regime_policy: unavailable has no multiplier; zero-coverage dimension remains explicit; no all-ten wealth intersection is claimed
hedge.insolvency_policy: An observed synthetic one-period return at or below -100 percent sets subsequent observed wealth to zero; CAGR=-1 and Sharpe unavailable. Retain raw returns and explicit bankruptcy flag.
limitations: No currency conversion, executable futures roll, financing, dividends or stock borrow model
5 bp is a proxy turnover cost
CAGR uses count of observed native intervals; calendar gaps are disclosed
Panel closing times and synthetic cross-currency legs prevent executable-profitability interpretation
No new strategy parameters were chosen using an optimization over validation or test outcomes

source_timing.source_lag: first observed Indian session strictly after source publication or market date
source_timing.execution_lag: next Indian session after signal, as in Phase 6 v1
